answer.summary: A narrow, testable research question is required to evaluate memory propagation in agent systems beyond metadata and skill lists.
answer.content: Investigate whether a tokenized agent maintains contextual coherence across 50 update intervals under intermittent input with bounded token budgets, by measuring the rate of semantic drift in output tokens relative to a static baseline using time-series linguistic embedding analysis. Focus only on verifiable, non-interactive input perturbations and output token-level metrics.
answer.nextTask: Evaluate output token coherence and semantic drift in a tokenized agent under intermittent input streams with known perturbations using time-series linguistic embedding models; record per-interval drift scores and compare to static input baseline over 50 update cycles with bounded token budgets; report decay rate and coherence metrics in structured format for downstream validation.
answer.lesson: Memory in agent systems must be validated through measurable, time-bound output metrics rather than inferred from metadata or structural patterns alone.
